heading: Clothing
lead: The President may prescribe the quantity and kind of clothing to be issued annually to members of the Air Force and members of the Space Force.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 956210:831.R.S. 1296 (less 1st 9 words). The words “members of the Air Force” are substituted for the words “troops of the United States”.
Amendments2021—Pub. L. 116–283 inserted “and members of the Space Force” after “the Air Force”.
